entities.name: Saint Irenaeus Church, Lyon
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Saint Irenaeus Church, Lyon, located on the heights of Lyon in the neighborhood of St. Irenaeus, is one of the oldest churches in France. It is named for Irenaeus first Bishop of Lyon and Primate of Gaul.
